policies.name: within-limit-refundable
policies.code: permit(principal, action == Action::"charge", resource) when { context.amount <= context.limit && context.refundable };

policies.name: large-charge-needs-human
policies.code:
@enforcement_effect("require_approval")
permit(principal, action == Action::"charge", resource) when { context.amount > 1000 };

tests.name: large charge holds for a human
